text.text: Made for the daily gathering at school pick-up and drop-off, this area is a welcoming buffer that stays open to the public all day.
Using Villimalé’s calm, natural setting, this centre offers active and restful routines for body and mind.

More daily needs can be met on foot: a place to wait at the school gate, a lively beach, a wellbeing centre and a maritime research centre. The waterfront and the research centre also give the rest of the island a reason to come.
The beach becomes a lively waterfront with small stalls, a holhuashi and a wellness centre, beside the former police sports ground, now open to the public.
A hub for marine study and research that joins environmental observation with public education, to build care for the ocean around the island.
